newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Fifteen feared killed as Pakistani boat capsizes.
newsitem.headline: Fifteen feared killed as Pakistani boat capsizes.

text.p: About 15 people were feared killed when a river boat capsized on Thursday in Pakistan's Punjab province, government officials said.

The boat was carrying about 45 people when it capsized in the river Ravi near the town of Nankana Sahib. Twent-four people were found alive, area Assistant Commissioner Khalid Majeed Pirzada said. He said eight bodies had been found so far.
